name: Sys.yearmon
title: An Index Class for Monthly Data

origin.details: Sys.yearmon returns as.yearmon(Sys.Date()), the local calendar month. The recorded value is yearmon(2000 + (3 - 1) / 12), which is March 2000, so the check does not depend on the clock.
origin.example:
x <- yearmon(2000 + (3 - 1) / 12)
cat(paste("yearmon", sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x)), format(x), sep = " "), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: The current local year and month.
translation.details: sys_yearmon reads date.today() and returns that calendar month as a Yearmon. The recorded value is yearmon(2000 + (3 - 1) / 12), March 2000, numeric 2000 + 2/12.
translation.example:
from zoo.yearmon import format_yearmon, yearmon
x = yearmon(2000 + (3 - 1) / 12)
print("yearmon", format(float(x.value[0]), ".17g"), format_yearmon(x)[0])
